label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Toda congregación de Israel lo harán.
spanish: Toda la congregación de Israel lo harán.
grammarChanges: Added the definite article: 'Toda congregación' → 'Toda la congregación', so the Spanish renders the construct singular כָּל עֲדַת as the whole/entire congregation rather than defaulting to a distributive 'every congregation.'
readerNote: Chose 'toda la congregación' (the whole congregation) over the article-less 'toda congregación' (every congregation) to match the construct singular כָּל עֲדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל, which names one specific congregation of Israel.
